criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 8 July 2028 (18 months after the 8 January 2027 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Calculates the long-stop date as 14 April 2027 (150 days after signing on 15 November 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 29 May 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.

Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 45-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (18 months) and as a date (8 July 2028), with days remaining from 14 December 2026 (572 days).
Notes that 8 July 2028 is a Saturday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 10 July 2028.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
